rules: Currently employed — never describe as 'ex-' the current company.
Only claim facts present in this profile; never invent metrics or titles.
Never flag location as a gap for roles in the candidate's country.
Flag any role where stated compensation is below the expected CTC minimum.
Scam screen every JD: generic/free email domains for senior roles, chat-app-first recruitment, any fee or deposit request, role missing from the company careers page.

formats.coverLetter: Compact India format: start directly with 'Dear Hiring Team,' — no sender name, address, or date block above it — then 2-3 short paragraphs, 3-5 bullet highlights, closing. Plain text.
formats.recruiterDm: Under 300 characters: one specific hook from the JD, one credibility point, one clear ask.

bullets: Built a partner-integration platform from zero to 40 enterprise partners with 99.9% API uptime in 6 months.
Led migration of legacy checkout serving 2M monthly orders with zero downtime and a 30% latency reduction.
Delivered privacy-compliance readiness across 5 product lines, passing audit on the first attempt.
Owned the seller-onboarding funnel for a B2C marketplace, cutting time-to-first-listing by 40%.
Partnered with engineering to ship a fraud-detection review queue, reducing chargebacks by 22%.
